name: ScrollElasticityEnum
description: Enumeration of scroll elasticity (touch scroll behavior) values for ScrollView.

staticFields.label: Clamped
staticFields.description: Clamped: scrolling is clamped at the content boundaries.

staticFields.label: Elastic
staticFields.description: Elastic: scrolling has elastic behavior when reaching boundaries.

staticFields.label: Unrestricted
staticFields.description: Unrestricted: scrolling is unrestricted and can go beyond boundaries.
